request: Add bill splitting: split the order total between `people` as evenly as possible in whole cents, the first shares taking any extra cents, e.g. 798 cents between 4 people is 200, 200, 199, 199. Fewer than one person fails with INVALID_QUANTITY; order problems fail with the same StoreError as the order total does.

signature.python: def split_bill(customer: Customer, lines: list[Line], people: int) -> list[Money]  # on failure: raise StoreFailure(StoreError.<reason>)
signature.jig: def split_bill(customer: Customer, lines: list[Line], people: int) -> Result[list[Money], StoreError]
